_README: Which recorded _runs/ directory backs which arm of which gate.
This file is DATA, not configuration you reason about: it changes every time a
solve lands, and run_construction.py writes it for you (gatespec.register_run).
Hand-editing is fine; keys must be gate keys from _gatelib/gatespec.py's SPECS
run_ids       : the run whose last checkpoint IS the arm.
trace_run_ids : a run kept only for its optimization trajectory (Figure 4).
Not inherited by rotated gates -- see GateSpec.trace_run_ids.
null / missing / a directory that does not exist  ->  that arm is simply absent
from ARM_ORDER and the notebook runs without it. A fresh gate therefore works
end-to-end on baselines A and B before any optimizer time has been spent.
What does NOT belong here: anything with a physics justification behind it.
Device and noise parameters live in curve_opt.device; what each arm IS lives in
_gatelib/armspec.py. Those carry derivations that JSON has no room for.
